claims.claim: 2026-10-26 官方最新穩定 C API release 為 4.8.1；下載 ZIP SHA256 與發布者 digest 相符。
claims.evidence_type: official release metadata plus local cryptographic checksum
claims.applicable_conditions: Pinned v4.8.1 C API ZIP, checked date only
claims.limitations: Latest may change after the review date; checksum establishes artifact identity, not scientific accuracy.

claims.claim: Windows x64 上以 GCC 15.2.0 編譯之 C 測試成功執行場景、材質、direct、parametric/convolution reflections 與三次釋放／重建生命週期。
claims.applicable_conditions: 1 source, 14 triangles, 4096 rays, 8 bounces, 2 threads, order1, 0.25s, 48kHz/512 samples; Windows NT 10.0.26200
claims.limitations: Not a calibrated acoustic validation, leak test, HRTF/listening test, production audio integration, or statistical performance benchmark.

claims.claim: 公開 IPLSimulationOutputs 沒有個別鏡面反射點序列、面序列或穩定 reflection Path ID；反射音場與可檢視鏡面路徑是不同能力。
claims.applicable_conditions: Steam Audio 4.8.1 public C API, not private engine internals
claims.limitations: Does not assert the solver has no internal rays; custom ray-tracer callbacks are not an ordered public reflection path contract.

claims.claim: IPLPathingVisualizationCallback 提供 probe 間 pathing 線段，不能將它標示為個別鏡面反射。
claims.limitations: No pathing runtime or baking test executed.

claims.claim: 官方 4.8.1 ZIP 內含 WASM 靜態庫並有 Emscripten source build 支援，但本機未完成瀏覽器連結／執行。
claims.evidence_type: downloaded archive and official source inspection
claims.limitations: No emcc on this machine; archive presence does not prove complete linking, threads, AudioWorklet, or browser performance.

claims.claim: IPLImpulseResponse/IPLEnergyField/IPLReconstructor 與 probe extraction 為公開 API；即時 IPLReflectionEffectIR 仍是不同的 opaque 型別。
claims.applicable_conditions: 4.8.1; baked energy extraction/reconstruction versus runtime reflection effect pipeline
claims.limitations: Only runtime effect Dirac rendering was executed; baked raw extraction/reconstruction not run. No unsafe handle casts permitted.

claims.claim: 預設 IPLMaterial 三頻帶中心為 400Hz、2.5kHz、15kHz；absorption 是吸收能量比例、scattering 是反射能量中散射比例、transmission 僅用於 direct occlusion。
claims.applicable_conditions: Official three-band SDK; not experimental octave-band source rebuild
claims.limitations: These bands are not arbitrary octave centers. Mapping measured data requires documented derivation; SDK output EQ coefficients should not be conflated with pressure reflection coefficients.

claims.claim: Steam Audio code 為 Apache-2.0，但官方 binary 包含個別第三方條款，不能將整包宣告為 Apache-only。
claims.evidence_type: full official licensing terms and package notice scan
claims.applicable_conditions: Pinned source and downloaded C API distribution; actual final linked inventory controls redistribution obligations
claims.limitations: Not legal advice or hackathon permission. No separate LICENSE/NOTICE filename in scanned ZIP; future redistribution must still include applicable license and notices.
